use default

let text = "the quick 🦊 brown fox"

let points =
    text.enumerate_runes() |> map(point => "{point}") |> collect_array()

slice(from: int, length: int) -> string =>
    points[from..from + length] |> join("")

starts_at(wanted: string) -> int is
    let target =
        wanted.enumerate_runes()
            |> map(point => "{point}")
            |> collect_array()

    for at in 0..points.count - target.count + 1 do
        if slice(at, target.count) =~ wanted then
            return at
        fi
    od

    return -1
si

write_line(slice(4, 5))
write_line(slice(4, points.count - 4))
write_line(slice(0, points.count - 1))
write_line(slice(starts_at("b"), 5))
write_line(slice(starts_at("fox"), 3))
